checker.reason: The new code runs NFKD normalization before lowercasing and filtering. NFKD splits é, Ü, ü, Ñ, ú and ã into a base letter plus a combining mark. encode('ascii','ignore') then drops the combining mark and keeps the base letter. So 'Café menu' gives 'cafe-menu', 'Überprüfung der Preise' gives 'uberprufung-der-preise' and 'Ñandú São Paulo' gives 'nandu-sao-paulo'. The kill-condition test checks exactly these cases, and the diff logic should pass it.
